# SEC investigation of Arqit discontinued without enforcement action


November 24, 2026 11:48 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0e61adac44fe2ff2cb80d008b543b58f/arqit/news/2026-11-24_SEC_investigation_of_Arqit_discontinued_without_134.pdf)


LONDON, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Arqit Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQQ), a global leader in quantum-safe encryption helping safeguard sensitive information from current and future cyber threat, confirms today that the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) staff have discontinued their investigation as to Arqit and are not recommending any enforcement against the company.


Arqit had been cooperating fully with the SEC investigation relating to the business combination between Arqit and Centricus Acquisition Corp., including by voluntarily producing documents.


**About Arqit**


Arqit Quantum Inc. (Nasdaq: ARQQ) provides quantum-safe encryption software used in government, defence and industry, helping protect sensitive data in transit and prepare for migration to post-quantum cryptography (PQC).


Arqit’s Encryption Intelligence platform identifies cryptography in use across an organisation and builds an inventory to inform PQC migration and support compliance planning.


Its software-defined encryption solutions, NetworkSecure™ and Sovereign Key Platform, enable secure interoperability across networks, cloud and edge environments and can be deployed at scale without replacing existing hardware. Sovereign Key Platform also supports confidential computing, helping organisations retain control over their encryption keys and data to address their data sovereignty requirements.


For more information, visit[www.arqitgroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=emnGUHqUPAghohQF4qrcLj4vt5zwbod4-0Km851GEO2uZghr-SmiDq8VgFMuY1JGyNbYZ20-4-liRP9MLO0jokPftkhy79EmzkG3t6Vpu-E=) .
